semantics.shadow: a new variable whose nearest visible outer local binding is a distinct variable
semantics.same_scope_short_reuse: existing local name on := with another new nonblank variable
semantics.reassignment: write to a known local identifier by =, compound op, increment/decrement, range =, or short reuse
semantics.declaration_redefinition_proposal: body variable declaration AND known local reassignment in the same function
semantics.branch: if, expression switch, type switch, select in the own function body
semantics.scope: own function body, receiver/parameters/results; nested anonymous function bodies excluded
semantics.type_switch_guard: one implicit binding per case; repeated guard source location is not an independent sample
semantics.excluded: package/import/universe bindings, field/index memory writes, nested closure internals, type resolution and edge gold

limitations: syntactic local binding observations are not independently reviewed dependency edges
go/types cross-check covers standalone development controls, not the complete project
existing exposed candidate pool; semantic independence and FINAL eligibility remain unreviewed
absence in this restricted census does not establish absence of other shadow mechanisms
read/write order, branch reachability, aliasing and may-reach edge sets are not derived
